# Franki Chamaki

> Official website and professional hub for Franki Chamaki, a Sydney-based AI Growth Marketer and GTM Systems Builder.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://www.frankichamaki.com/) - AI growth marketing, GTM systems, demand generation and selected outcomes
- [About Franki Chamaki](https://www.frankichamaki.com/about/) - Background, experience, working approach and tools
- [AI & GTM Systems Projects](https://www.frankichamaki.com/projects/) - Index of documented AI and GTM builds


## What I do
- [What I Do](https://www.frankichamaki.com/what-i-do/) - Capability hub for AI-powered GTM and growth systems
- [Signal-Based GTM](https://www.frankichamaki.com/what-i-do/signal-based-gtm/) - ICP scoring, account intelligence, buying signals and prioritisation
- [AI Sales Intelligence](https://www.frankichamaki.com/what-i-do/ai-sales-intelligence/) - CRM context, account signals and pre-call intelligence
- [AI Outbound & ABM](https://www.frankichamaki.com/what-i-do/ai-outbound-abm/) - Account selection, personalisation and multichannel sales sequences
- [AI Growth Automation](https://www.frankichamaki.com/what-i-do/ai-growth-automation/) - Agents and workflows connecting data, reasoning and action
- [AI Search Visibility](https://www.frankichamaki.com/what-i-do/ai-search-visibility/) - Technical SEO, AEO/GEO, schema and content architecture
- [Growth Experimentation](https://www.frankichamaki.com/what-i-do/growth-experimentation/) - Paid acquisition, conversion, attribution and test-and-learn systems

## Documented AI & GTM builds
- [Contact Intel](https://www.frankichamaki.com/projects/contact-intel/) - Claude-powered pre-call intelligence used in Slack, combining HubSpot history, Clay growth signals and live company and sector news
- [Target Account Intelligence Agent](https://www.frankichamaki.com/projects/target-account-intelligence/) - Clay, Apify and Claude workflow monitoring growth signals across 146 target accounts and posting weekly Slack briefs
- [EngineRoom](https://www.frankichamaki.com/projects/engineroom/) - AI-assisted event follow-up from badge scan to HubSpot enrichment, follow-up brief and Gmail draft
- [Shadow AI Diagnostic](https://www.frankichamaki.com/projects/shadow-ai-diagnostic/) - Anonymous AI-readiness survey and founder report built with Next.js, Supabase, HubSpot and Claude

## Professional project
